investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Coralwave Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure centralindia (zones centralindia-1/centralindia-2/centralindia-3); network range 10.116.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-03, maxmemory 12gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the reservations-api PostgreSQL database reservations-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
